AboutDescription: A local application for recording PowerShell 7 sessions.
AboutLimitations: This version records PowerShell 7 sessions on Ubuntu through GNOME Terminal. Windows PowerShell 5.1, elevation, macOS, and other terminal emulators are not supported. History lists only sessions recorded with Save session in history checked. Older transcript files are not imported. Recording started does not mean the process is still running. A transcript file is deleted only after confirmation, and only when its footer shows that the transcript finished.
UpdatesAutomaticHelp: When this is on, the application contacts GitHub at most once every 24 hours to read the latest stable release. It does not send customer TAGs, session names, transcripts, or settings.
